properties.label: Recordings page: [CONTEXT_PATH]/blackbox/  ·  Admins can always upload, view and delete.

properties.name: uploadPermission
properties.label: Who can upload

properties.name: viewPermission
properties.label: Who can view all recordings

properties.name: deletePermission
properties.label: Who can delete any recording
properties.description: Empty = admins only. Applies to the recordings they can view.

properties.name: ownerAccess
properties.label: Uploaders can view and delete their own recordings

properties.name: maxSizeMb
properties.label: Max file size (MB)
properties.description: Applies to the video and to session.json separately.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of MB.

properties.label: System logs: the extension tags the recorded tab's requests, and their Joget log lines are kept with the recording.

properties.name: captureSystemLogs
properties.label: Capture system logs during recordings

properties.name: systemLogPermission
properties.label: Who can view system logs
properties.description: Empty = admins only. They must also be able to view the recording.

properties.name: ownServerData
properties.label: Uploaders can view the server data of their own recordings
properties.description: System logs, traces, server load and System Info (license key, system properties). No = only the users above.

properties.name: systemLogMaxMb
properties.label: Max size of system logs per recording (MB)
properties.description: Lines after this are dropped; the viewer says the log was cut off.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of MB.

properties.name: systemLogKeepDays
properties.label: Delete system logs not uploaded after (days)
properties.description: Captured lines wait on the server until the recording is uploaded.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of days.

properties.name: captureGauges
properties.label: Sample server load during recordings
properties.description: Needs "Capture system logs during recordings". Every second: heap, GC time, CPU, busy request threads and database connections, shown as the Server load strip.

properties.name: captureTraces
properties.label: Copy Glowroot traces of slow and failed requests
properties.description: Needs "Capture system logs during recordings". Glowroot's own slow threshold decides which requests have a trace; it is not changed.

properties.name: captureGlowrootData
properties.label: Copy Glowroot data for the recording
properties.description: Needs "Capture system logs during recordings" and Glowroot 0.14 on each node. About a minute after a recording stops, each node cuts the recording out of its Glowroot data, in Glowroot's own format: the traces of the recorded requests, plus the aggregates and gauges of all traffic during the recording. Download it on the replay page and open it in a standalone Glowroot. Each build needs free disk space in Joget's temp folder of about the size of Glowroot's data.h2.db (it is skipped, with the reason, when there is not enough).

properties.name: captureAllServerLogs
properties.label: Also capture all other server log lines during recordings
properties.description: Needs "Capture system logs during recordings". Keeps every log line written while a recording runs, not only those of the recorded tab's requests: scheduler jobs, email, background threads and other users' requests (shown greyed, under a filter). Only for recordings started by users allowed by "Who can view system logs", since the lines can hold other users' data. Busy servers fill the max size faster.

properties.name: glowrootUrl
properties.label: Glowroot address
properties.description: Empty = the Glowroot agent of this Joget (found from its admin.json, usually http://localhost:4000). Read as Glowroot's anonymous user.

properties.label: Support data: what a support engineer needs besides the recording. Shown only to users who may view system logs.

properties.name: recentChangesDays
properties.label: Recent changes period (days)
properties.description: The Info tab's first section lists the app versions, plugin jars and wflow files changed in this period, and a Joget restart. Taken at recording start, with the System Info snapshot.

properties.name: includeAppExport
properties.label: Export the apps used in the recording
properties.description: At upload, the apps found in the recorded URLs (at most 5, most used first; App Center left out) are exported with Joget's own app export (.jwa, without form data, plugins or groups) and kept with the recording. App definitions can hold plugin settings and environment variables.

properties.name: sampleData
properties.label: Add sample form data to the exported apps
properties.description: Added to each .jwa like Joget's own export with data, so importing it imports them: the records the recording opened or saved, rows of the app's other tables that point at them, and the newest rows of tables with none. Values are masked: same length, letters, digits and symbols, but fake (options, yes/no and small numbers kept). Uploaded files become placeholders. Only for uploaders who may see the recording's server data.

properties.name: sampleRows
properties.label: Newest rows per table when the recording touched none

properties.name: sampleKeepIds
properties.label: Record ids in sample data
properties.description: New ids (default): every record gets a new unique id, also where other rows point at it, so importing never overwrites existing rows; the App tab lists old and new ids. Keep the original ids only for a server where overwriting is fine.

properties.name: allowRealSampleData
properties.label: Allow real values in sample data
properties.description: When Yes, users allowed by "Who can view system logs" can tick "Use real values" when they upload. Columns matching the always-masked names stay masked.

properties.name: sensitiveColumns
properties.label: Always-masked column names
properties.description: Comma-separated words. A column whose name has one as a word (ic_no, homeAddress, email-2) is always masked, also with real values.
properties.value: password, ic, nric, passport, email, phone, mobile, tel, address, salary, birth, dob, bank, account, card, iban, ssn
